meta.name: session-handoff
meta.description: Generate a structured handoff document capturing current progress, open tasks, key decisions, and context needed to resume work. Use when ending a session, saying "continue later", "save progress", "session summary", or "pick up where I left off".

copy.tagline: 生成工作进度摘要，方便后续继续
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要中断工作并记录当前进展
copy.tagline_en: Generate a structured handoff document to resume work later
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to pause work and capture progress for later

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你结束会话时自动生成一份交接文档，记录当前进度、未完成任务、关键决策和上下文，方便下次继续工作。
howto.when: 当你说“handoff”、“continue later”、“save progress”等关键词，或明确表示要结束会话并希望下次顺利恢复时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份会话交接文档。
保存进度，我稍后再继续。
say.note: Claude 会记录未完成的工作和下一步行动。

say.text: 记录本次会话的关键决策和学习。
say.note: Claude 会列出决策理由和学到的东西。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically generates a structured handoff document when you end a session, capturing current progress, open tasks, key decisions, and context needed to resume work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "handoff", "continue later", "save progress", or similar phrases, or when you indicate ending a session and wanting to resume smoothly.

say_en.note: Claude will gather current state and output a markdown handoff.
Claude will record unfinished work and next steps.

say_en.text: Log key decisions and learnings from this session.
say_en.note: Claude will list decisions with reasoning and learnings.
